name: bookmark-tab-title
description: Chrome/Chromium extension that shows the bookmark name as the tab title

scripts.test: node --test tests/match.test.js tests/settings.test.js tests/backup.test.js tests/locales.test.js tests/manifest.test.js
scripts.package: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -qr dist/bookmark-tab-title-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json LICENSE src _locales icons fonts -x '*.DS_Store'
